bio.text: Wayne Rogers is the Democratic nominee for Alabama secretary of state in 2026 and a first-time political candidate.
He is a lawyer and executive assistant to the Jefferson County sheriff, and lives in Birmingham.
He is a former chair of the Jefferson County Democratic Party.
He earned a B.A. in music from Samford University in 1984 and a J.D. from Samford's Cumberland School of Law in 1988.

sources.title: Rogers, Dobson lay out contrasting plans for Alabama secretary of state's office
